This was a read-only review of rule text. I made no edits, rendered no UI and ran no project implementation. Citations are `file:line` in `steps/` and `src/skills/design-taste/SKILL.md`.

## Decisions

**(1) Step 0 and Next.js: No, it must not install Next immediately.**
- `step-0-environment-setup:315`: "Scaffold here only when the project already has an explicit, approved stack choice… defer framework installation to Step 2… do not silently make Next.js or any agent framework mandatory."
- The platform HARD-GATE at `:334` offers "Defer scaffold — existing project or architecture choice still open".
- The approval gate at `:632` offers "Skip/defer… record why".
- `:232` adds "If stack is unclear, defer to Step 2."
- Remaining contradiction: `:337` says "Record the selection in `docs/stack-profile.json` under `"platform"` before continuing". It gives no value for a deferred choice, so an agent could feel pushed to pick one. The Phase C.1 title "(NEW PROJECT ONLY)" next to `:317` "confirmed new project" is also slightly ambiguous.

**(2) Step 5 without Pen: Yes, it can proceed on the Direct path, with the path re-selected at the gate.**
- `step-5:129`: "If the chosen path cannot yield an artifact and evidence, re-run Phase A and select the other path. Do not pretend a tool-specific export exists."
- `:263`: "record that gap and switch paths only after the existing approval rule is satisfied."
- Pen is only preferred: `:102` says "A chosen tool may be Pen, Stitch, or another verified canvas."
- Proof needed for Direct:
  - the stack-native screen artifacts (HTML or native scaffolds, `:115`, `:191`);
  - "Rendered artifact or reviewed diff with recorded evidence" (`:122`);
  - inventory columns for artifact path, render evidence "or unavailable", and approval evidence (`:227-229`);
  - screenshots only "when a compatible renderer is available… If no renderer is available, record the missing evidence as a gap; do not report a visual pass" (`:389`, `:592`, `:621`).
- Approval must be actual: `:104` says "Never invent… approval".
- Remaining contradiction: `:590` lists "Screenshot evidence missing for any screen (375px + 1440px)" as an unconditional failure. That conflicts with the recorded-gap allowance in `:592` and `:621`.

**(3) Existing brand with Inter and purple: No, taste does not have to change it.**
- `design-taste/SKILL.md:35`: "Inter, purple, centered layouts… are not inherently wrong. Challenge unexamined defaults; preserve intentional choices that serve the product. Respect the approved Step 3 direction."
- `:18` requires classifying the work as "greenfield, preserve, or an explicitly authorized overhaul".
- Remaining contradiction: `step-5:441` says "NEVER use Inter, Roboto, Arial as defaults". It is absolute in tone and has no brand-preserve carve-out, although "as defaults" arguably limits it.
- Step 9 is consistent with the skill on purple. `step-9:320` says "if it happens to be that hue, document the deliberate choice", and `:635` bans only the "AI-purple *default* accent".

**(4) AI-written diary entries as testimonials: No, Step 9 cannot use them as customer proof.**
- `step-9-landing-page:217`: "Write 3–5 clearly labeled empathy hypotheses unless actual diary-research consent and records exist. Never present synthetic first-person entries as interviews or customer quotations."
- This is reinforced three ways:
  - `:339` bans any testimonial "not from a real, attributable person with their role and company";
  - `:348` and `:654` require a truthful-copy pass;
  - `:607` says "no testimonials you don't have".
- The entries may inform empathy and messaging only.
- Remaining contradiction: the frontmatter (`:4`), the phase table (`:60`), the gate prompt (`:231`) and the checklist (`:700`, `:737`) still call them "diary entries", not "empathy hypotheses".

**(5) Replacing a two-week appetite with "M": No, task handoff cannot do that.**
- `step-11.5-task-handoff:58`: "Appetite is copied verbatim from the approved Step 10/11 time budget; it is not an effort estimate. Retain a legacy S/M/L value only as an unresolved size label, never infer a duration from it."
- The templates at `:80` and `:341` read "[approved fixed time budget from Step 10]".
- `step-10:333` says appetite is "not a generic size label or estimate".
- Remaining contradiction: the confirm-task-list example at `step-11.5:242-243` still shows Appetite values `M` and `S`. `step-10:264` still says "L features that should be broken down". Both model the banned pattern.

**(6) Required cross-model evaluation with no reviewer: No, same-model self-review cannot clear it. The gate is blocked.**
- `step-13-skillpack-generator:173`: "If a required independent model/provider is unavailable, record the gate as blocked; deterministic checks or same-model self-review cannot silently replace it."
- `:159`: "A same-model check is supplemental and must be labeled; it does not clear a required cross-model gate."
- Remaining contradiction: none inside Step 13. The `:167` examples (`codex exec`, `claude -p`) do not say the judge must differ from the authoring model, so they depend on `:159` to supply that. I did not check Step 11 or Step 14, which `:173` treats as binding.

## Summary

| # | Decision | Text status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | No forced Next install | Clean; deferred `platform` value undefined |
| 2 | Proceed on Direct, with gaps recorded | `:590` conflicts with `:592`/`:621` |
| 3 | Preserve the brand | `step-5:441` is absolute |
| 4 | Not usable as proof | Naming residue only |
| 5 | Copy verbatim | Example rows `M`/`S`, Step 10 "L" |
| 6 | Blocked | Clean in Step 13; Steps 11/14 unchecked |

## Limits of this review

I read only the matching sections of the canonical `steps/` files and the design-taste skill. I did not read the full step files, and I did not check the rendered `commands/` mirrors against them.

**About the pasted Python script:** I did not run it. It spawns a nested `claude --print` probe and writes `docs/audits/methodology-refresh-2026-09-19/CLAUDE-METHOD-PROBE.json`. This session has only Read, Grep and Glob, and your request said no edits, so no probe JSON exists from this session. If you want that artifact, run the script yourself. The answers above are my direct read of the same sources.
